build.name: extract the appendix sources from the RFC text, then compile with -DMD=5
build.cmd: sed -n '/^A\.1 global\.h/,/^A\.2 md5\.h/p' rfc1321.txt | sed '1d;$d' | grep -v '\[Page ' | grep -v '^RFC 1321' | tr -d '\f' | awk '{ if ($0 ~ /^[[:space:]]*$/ && cont) next; print; cont = ($0 ~ /\\[[:space:]]*$/) }' > global.h; sed -n '/^A\.2 md5\.h/,/^A\.3 md5c\.c/p' rfc1321.txt | sed '1d;$d' | grep -v '\[Page ' | grep -v '^RFC 1321' | tr -d '\f' | awk '{ if ($0 ~ /^[[:space:]]*$/ && cont) next; print; cont = ($0 ~ /\\[[:space:]]*$/) }' > md5.h; sed -n '/^A\.3 md5c\.c/,/^A\.4 mddriver\.c/p' rfc1321.txt | sed '1d;$d' | grep -v '\[Page ' | grep -v '^RFC 1321' | tr -d '\f' | awk '{ if ($0 ~ /^[[:space:]]*$/ && cont) next; print; cont = ($0 ~ /\\[[:space:]]*$/) }' > md5c.c; sed -n '/^A\.4 mddriver\.c/,/^A\.5 Test suite/p' rfc1321.txt | sed '1d;$d' | grep -v '\[Page ' | grep -v '^RFC 1321' | tr -d '\f' | awk '{ if ($0 ~ /^[[:space:]]*$/ && cont) next; print; cont = ($0 ~ /\\[[:space:]]*$/) }' > mddriver.c; wc -l global.h md5.h md5c.c mddriver.c; gcc -w -DMD=5 -o mddriver md5c.c mddriver.c 2>&1 | head -5; test -x ./mddriver && echo BUILT
